Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Geometric Framed Hanging Mirror, 23.75"H, Black
Colors: Black
Materials: metal
This beautiful geometric mirror is a wonderfully modern take on a timeless classic. Perfect in any room of your house, it will be an instant eye-catcher and will bring the desired pizzazz to any living space. 23.75"H x 20"W x 2"D Made of hand-painted metal and glass Can be used as a standard mirror or an accent piece This beautiful work of craftsmanship is the perfect marriage of functionality and grace. Avoid moisture and wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Hardware not included.
